Ladder7 has clients in the UAE, the UK (London), Germany, Ireland, the USA, Singapore, Australia, Vietnam and India. We take on projects from across the GCC, Europe and Africa.
India is 1.5 hours ahead of the UAE, 2.5 hours ahead of Saudi Arabia and Kenya, 3.5 hours ahead of South Africa and Central Europe in summer, and 4.5 to 5.5 hours ahead of the UK and Nigeria.

content.text: For international clients
Outsourcing software development to Ladder7
How much does it cost to outsource software development to Ladder7?

Cost depends on scope and engagement model. Ladder7 offers enterprise-grade quality at affordable, flexible pricing: fixed-price projects, monthly dedicated teams or time-and-materials work, with a costed estimate after reviewing your brief.
Which countries does Ladder7 work with?
Ladder7 has clients in the UAE, the UK (London), Germany, Ireland, the USA, Singapore, Australia, Vietnam and India. We take on projects from across the GCC, Europe and Africa.
What is the time difference with India?
India is 1.5 hours ahead of the UAE, 2.5 hours ahead of Saudi Arabia and Kenya, 3.5 hours ahead of South Africa and Central Europe in summer, and 4.5 to 5.5 hours ahead of the UK and Nigeria.
Who owns the intellectual property?
The client. Contracts assign all code and IP to you and include an NDA. For European clients we also sign Data Processing Agreements with Standard Contractual Clauses.
Which currency do you invoice in?
We invoice in the client's local currency, or in USD or INR if the client prefers.
How do we communicate during a project?
Through your preferred tools such as Slack, Teams, Jira or email, with sprint demos every two weeks and a named delivery manager.
